title: Soldier with a rifle in a green doorway — unnamed; "this is not Stanton"
description: A young soldier in eyeglasses grins in the doorway of a green board-and-batten building, an early M16-family rifle across his chest. Larry does not know who he is. The name first offered for him as a guess, Stanton, was withdrawn on 2026-09-05 when Larry looked again: "This is not Stanton." Of the man, or of the men like him: "He was ex helicopter school. Most of the guys in my Unit were ex-helicopter school because they had the radio experience from the school but couldn't make it in."
researchNotes: Two comments, in opposite directions. 2026-08-15 (paraphrase, giscus-vn-0026-c18035534.json): "A guess name he said is PFC Stanton." 2026-09-05 (transcribed, giscus-vn-0026-c18308443.json): "This is not Stanton." The later, first-person statement withdraws the earlier guess, so the person link is removed and the man reverts to unnamed; Stanton himself is now a real and separately described person (data/people/pfc-stanton.json) who is not in this frame. The 'ex helicopter school' remark is the more useful thing in the comment for the unit question (#2): a unit staffed with men washed out of helicopter school for their radio training describes an aviation-support signal element rather than a flying one. The building — permanent, painted, with a louvered gable vent — is not identified; the survey's thought that it is at the headquarters base is a hypothesis only.
